hero.description: Afrisight, a platform with over a million users, needed a comprehensive redesign of its online platform and dashboard to improve usability, increase engagement, and streamline data presentation for both survey participants and corporate clients. The redesign aimed to modernize the user interface, simplify navigation, and provide a seamless mobile experience. The outcome was a significant boost in user satisfaction, retention, and corporate client satisfaction, with measurable success metrics post-launch.

projectGoals.description: The overarching goal was to improve the user experience and modernize the UI across the Afrisight platform and dashboard. The main objectives were:

objectives.text: Ensure users can easily access surveys, track rewards, and manage profiles.
Provide clear visual feedback on survey progress and rewards to motivate users.
Deliver actionable and visually clear insights for corporate clients through intuitive dashboards.
Align the design with Afrisight’s brand while creating an engaging, modern interface.
Ensure a seamless, responsive experience for mobile users.

problem.description: Afrisight’s platform and dashboard were facing the following challenges:

challenges.text: Users struggled to find surveys, track rewards, and update profiles efficiently.
Survey participants lacked motivation due to unclear progress and reward tracking.
Corporate clients found it difficult to interpret data insights and access reports.
The platform lacked a modern, user-friendly interface, impacting user retention.
Poor responsiveness created frustration for mobile users, who form a large segment of Afrisight’s audience.

solution.description: The overarching goal was to improve the user experience and modernize the UI across the Afrisight platform and dashboard. The main objectives were:

text: Created a sidebar navigation for easy access to “Surveys”, “Rewards”, “Profile”, and “Insights”.
Prioritized survey visibility and direct access to actionable tasks.
Designed interactive progress bars, pie charts, and graphs for clear tracking of survey completion and rewards.
Simplified corporate dashboards with visually clear reports.
Ensured full responsiveness, optimizing layouts for both large and small screens.
Added a prominent “Available Surveys” button on the mobile homepage for one-tap access.
Refreshed color schemes, typography, and iconography to reflect Afrisight’s brand.
Added microinteractions for better user feedback and engagement.
Implemented high-contrast ratios and large tap targets for inclusivity.
Used straightforward language for navigation labels to enhance usability.

outcomes.description: The overarching goal was to improve the user experience and modernize the UI across the Afrisight platform and dashboard. The main objectives were:

objectives.text: Survey participation rates increased by 42% post-redesign, driven by better navigation and progress tracking.
User retention grew by 24% due to an improved mobile experience and engaging interface.
Corporate clients reported a 52% reduction in time spent extracting insights from dashboards, thanks to simplified and clear data visualizations.
The user base expanded by 20% within six months of the redesign, surpassing the 1 million user mark, as the platform became more user-friendly and efficient.
Mobile users experienced a seamless and engaging interface, contributing to a 63% increase in survey completion via mobile devices.

hero.description: Tango Africa’s old website struggled with outdated visuals, poor navigation, and a lack of mobile responsiveness, limiting user engagement and event discovery. Tasked with redesigning the platform, I created a modern, user-friendly, and responsive website that improved usability, highlighted events, and encouraged app downloads. By focusing on a clean layout, vibrant visuals, and mobile-first design, the new website successfully aligned with Tango Africa’s mission to connect users with exciting local events, resulting in higher engagement and a stronger brand presence.

projectGoals.description: The old Tango Africa website faced significant usability and design issues:

objectives.text: Create a fresh, vibrant design aligned with Tango Africa’s brand and mission.
Make events a focal point of the design, improving visibility and engagement.
Ensure the website provides a seamless experience across all devices, particularly mobile.
Highlight events effectively with dynamic visuals and easy-to-access event details.
Position the app as the main access point for users and drive downloads with clear CTAs.

problem.description: The old Tango Africa website presented several challenges that hindered its ability to engage users effectively:

challenges.text: The old design lacked modern aesthetics, making the website appear unappealing and outdated compared to competitors.
The structure lacked hierarchy, making it difficult for users to find key information about the event.
Events were not showcased prominently, limiting users' ability to discover and engage with them.
The old website was not fully optimized for mobile devices, leading to poor user experiences on smaller screens.
The website failed to guide users effectively, resulting in unclear paths for discovering events, learning about features, or downloading the app.
The site did not reflect Tango Africa’s vibrant identity as a gateway to exciting local events.

solution.description: To address the challenges, I implemented a comprehensive redesign that focused on user-centric design principles and modern web standards:

text: Simplified the website structure, starting with a prominent hero section featuring a bold tagline (Find More Of The Events You Love), and a search field. This created a clear entry point for users.

Designed visually appealing event cards with high-quality images and concise details (event name, location, and category). Events were made a focal point of the website, helping users find relevant activities effortlessly.

Adopted a responsive design approach to ensure a seamless experience across all devices. The layout, buttons, and navigation were optimized for mobile users, who could now access information easily on smaller screens.

Refreshed the website with a clean, vibrant aesthetic using a neutral background, pops of teal and blue for highlights, and modern typography. This aligned the design with Tango Africa’s energetic and engaging brand.
Placed app store buttons prominently above the footer section, complemented by mobile screenshots to demonstrate the app’s functionality and benefits, driving more downloads.
Integrated an FAQ section to address common queries and provided clear contact information to improve user support.

outcomes.description: The design changes led to the following results:

objectives.text: The redesigned navigation and streamlined layout made it easier for users to explore events, access information, and download the app with fewer clicks.
The event-centric design increased visibility and engagement, helping users discover events more effectively.
With a fully responsive design, the website now delivers a seamless experience across devices, particularly for mobile users.
Clear CTAs and prominent app promotion led to a noticeable increase in app downloads.
The refreshed, modern design reflects Tango Africa’s mission and vibrancy, building user trust and loyalty.

hero.description: Choto is a mobile app that connects energy producers with users who rent energy services via various assets. As the UX/UI designer, I was tasked with creating an intuitive interface and smooth user experience for both agents and users across multiple service levels.

projectGoals.description: The primary goal was to create a seamless user experience across multiple panels for different user types. The objectives included:

objectives.text: Simplify the process of selecting energy services and viewing available assets.
Provide clear visuals and feedback for task completion and energy usage.
Ensure that agents can easily manage users and assets within the app.
Design a user-friendly interface for easy navigation across different service levels.

problem.description: The app faced challenges in simplifying workflows for both agents and users, including:

challenges.text: Users and agents found it difficult to navigate the service options and available assets.
Agents struggled with managing and assigning energy assets to users.
Users did not have clear insights into their energy usage or reward status.

solution.description: To resolve these issues, I implemented the following solutions:

text: Created clear navigation paths for users and agents to select and view available services.
Organized asset categories based on user and agent needs for quick access.
Redesigned the dashboard to provide agents with easy access to user profiles and assets.
Introduced task management features to help agents track and manage service assignments.
Integrated real-time energy usage stats and reward tracking for users.
Displayed visual indicators to show energy consumption and available rewards.

outcomes.description: The solution led to the following results:

objectives.text: Users and agents were able to navigate through the app with fewer clicks and clearer guidance.
User engagement improved due to clearer energy usage and rewards visibility.
Agents reported higher efficiency in managing users and assets.
